description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a team building detection models and products that help identify fraud and protect trust. You will own technical problems end to end, from analyzing evidence to shipping tools that support fraud analysts and trust teams.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and ship detection models and the systems and products around them.

 - Evaluate model and system performance honestly, including identifying failure modes.

 - Work directly with trust and fraud teams to turn evidence into decisions and usable workflows.

 - Adapt detection systems as adversaries change their tactics.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Technical experience in at least one relevant area: computer vision or image forensics, speech or audio modeling, video or temporal analysis, ML infrastructure, evaluation or calibration, fraud, identity, trust and safety, or full-stack product engineering.

 - Experience owning technical problems end to end and building and shipping detection models, supporting systems, or products.

 - Technical experience in synthetic media detection, media forensics, fraud, identity, or trust and safety.

 - Experience measuring performance, identifying failure modes, and iterating as adversaries adapt.

 - Experience working with trust or fraud teams to turn evidence into decisions and product workflows.


LOCATION

New York, United States. The work arrangement is not specified.
